title: Looks: one controller, selectable visual styles
description:
## Goal

Diverge from upstream Exposé: fix, simplify, and restructure so several selectable "looks"
(grid, cover-flow carousel, 3D workspace strata, glass HUD, CRT) share one controller and are
chosen from the settings menu.

## Diagnosis (cm-dr0)

Weakest part: controller and visuals are braided. The Overview* inheritance chain is one
~200-member object whose base layers call derived ones (7 new missing-property lint warnings);
selection is an index into a list rebuilt on every change (manual remaps, modelRevision bumps,
drift when a window closes); WindowCard mixes per-window model data, shared capture mechanics,
and grid-only visuals; each setting is defined in 4-6 places that already drifted. The gates
cannot catch any of this: `Color` resolves to Qt 6.12's QtQuick Color in tests and lint, so
theme-runtime/qmllint/settings-lint are red for an unrelated reason (and hid a real bug:
`integratedFooter` id shadowing the bool in WindowCard).
Smallest move first: make the gates trustworthy, then pull a non-visual controller out from
under the grid.

## Moves (children, in order)

1. Gates: qualified `qs.Commons` import everywhere; lint resolves Commons; see each gate red on a known bad case.
2. Dead code: unused functions/params/imports, 1:1 wrappers.
3. Selection by reference: selected/preview/hovered/origin toplevels instead of indices; origin used wherever Hyprland.activeToplevel was compared while open.
4. Composition: OverviewController (non-visual) + settings object + views via signals; HotCorner component.
5. Settings schema driving values, setters, IPC, pages.
6. Look interface; current grid becomes the Grid look; Look selector in settings.
7. New looks, one per bead.

## Operator decision

2026-10-22, operator's words verbatim:
- "at this point I'm ready to diverge from original code base, start fixing and /simplify the code, and refactoring it so that we can try all the concepts from the new settings menu selection for different looks and feels."
- Gate fix question -> "Yes, fix gates (Recommended)": approves changing validate's lint setup (link qs.Commons into the lint dir, drop per-file `qmllint disable import` comments) together with qualified imports.
- Footer bug question -> "Intended per-style look": only Rail gets the framed background; Floating/Overlay/Centered become frameless.
- Activation question -> "In-shell, no delay (Recommended)": replace activate-window with Hyprland.dispatch after the surface unmaps; the keep-pointer path may keep one small spawn.
- Feature cuts question: no option selected. No feature removals are approved (split in/out timing, footer-hide dialog, hover/selection split, legacy settings-key readers all stay).

This approves exactly the above: the refactoring scope of moves 1-7, the gate/lint change in move 1, the footer rendering policy, and the activation change. Nothing else: any test edit or removal, other gate/guard/lint change, feature removal, or other policy choice goes back to the operator.


2026-10-22 (later), operator's answers verbatim:
- Test edit question -> "Yes, 3 → 4": approves updating tests/theme/shell.qml expectedCounts[1] from 3 to 4 for the added Selection highlight control.
- Host lint question -> "Disable rule for host splice": approves passing `--block-scope-var-declaration disable` to qmllint in tests/check-settings-runtime only (host functions spliced from /usr/share/omarchy/shell); our own files stay fully checked by validate.

- Test stubs question -> "Yes, for this epic": approves updating tests/theme/shell.qml's stand-in controller when beads 3-7 rename or replace controller members, provided no assertion is removed or weakened; new tests may be added; changes to existing assertions still go back to the operator.

- Look picker question -> "New 'Look' page first (Recommended)": approves a dedicated first settings page for the look, and updating the theme test's page count/order and expectedCounts to match (assertion values only, no assertion removed).


2026-10-22 (after the refactor beads closed), operator's words verbatim:
- "let's fix the remainig issues and workarounds. and the start working on the looks in sequence"

This approves: fixing the two known defects reported at the end of move 6 (Settings opened over IPC
while closed lacks keyboard focus; the origin mark missing after a shell restart until focus changes)
and removing workarounds in our own code, each as its own bead; then building the looks one bead at a
time in the proposed order (carousel, workspace strata, glass HUD, CRT terminal). Assumption
(flagged, cm-vph): "in sequence" means that order. Nothing else: test edits/removals, gate changes,
and feature removals still go back to the operator.


2026-10-22 (during the carousel bead), operator's words verbatim:
- "it was me typing. let's what in 3d gamming called juice (individual effects should be a new option"
- Juice question -> "Springy motion (Recommended), Edge bump (Recommended), Activation punch (Recommended), Pulse + pointer tilt"
  (question text: each becomes its own on/off toggle on a new 'Juice' settings page, applying to every look where it makes sense)
- Live tests question -> "Just go ahead": live keyboard tests may run without a warning.

This approves: a Juice settings page with one boolean setting per effect (springy motion, edge bump,
activation punch, selection pulse, pointer tilt). Assumption (flagged, cm-vph): as with the Look page,
approving the page approves updating tests/theme/shell.qml's page count/order and expectedCounts values
for it (assertion values only, none removed). Defaults: all effects on (assumption, flagged).

- Punch question (60 fps recording: overlay gone ~50 ms after Enter, punch invisible) -> "Hold close ~180 ms (Recommended)":
  approves delaying the overlay close by ~180 ms, only while Activation punch is on; with punch off,
  activation stays instant. This narrows the earlier "In-shell, no delay" decision for that one toggle.

title: Gates: qualified qs.Commons import; lint resolves Commons
description: Color resolves to QtQuick's Color under Qt 6.12 in the theme fixture and qmllint, so theme-runtime/qmllint/settings-lint are red for an unrelated reason. Switch every file to a qualified import of qs.Commons, make validate's lint dir resolve Commons, drop per-file qmllint disable import comments (approved in epic Operator decision).
acceptance_criteria: check-theme-runtime and qmllint green except findings that are real; each gate shown red on a known bad case first (cm-yzv); live shell shows no new warnings.
close_reason: Qualified qs.Commons import in all files (3576359); theme-runtime green after red on a stale focus count; settings-lint green after red on a planted bad call. Lint still reports real findings owned by later beads: unused imports and block-scoped var (6w7.2), base-to-derived calls (6w7.4), integratedFooter id shadowing (6w7.6). Linking Commons into lint was tried and reverted: host singletons type their groups as QtObject, giving 159 false positives.

title: Typed settings layer; drop missing-property lint disables
description:
What: the four `// qmllint disable missing-property` in Overview.qml exist because keyCatcher.settingsLayer.item is untyped. Cast it to SettingsView (as the look is cast to Look) so lint checks those calls. The other disables (uncreatable-type PanelWindow, missing-type BackgroundEffect, signal-handler-parameters on Process.onExited) stem from Quickshell type info qmllint lacks; classify each with evidence and keep or remove.

Acceptance: no missing-property disables; a misspelled SettingsView method in Overview.qml fails ./validate (seen red); ./validate green.
close_reason: OverviewCanvas.settings typed SettingsView; Overview.keyboardCanvas(): OverviewCanvas; surface forwarders and the hostWindow.focusFirstSettingsControl round trip removed. Planted misspellings (moveSettingFocus, focusSettingCategory) fail qmllint; note ?. after a call drops the type, so explicit checks are used. Stale disables removed (missing-type BackgroundEffect, signal-handler-parameters: lint clean without them). Kept: uncreatable-type PanelWindow x2, qmllint reports 'Type PanelWindow is not creatable' from Quickshell type info though it is created at runtime. validate green, live focus checks green, smoke clean.

title: Carousel look: cover-flow of live previews
description:
## Diagnosis (cm-dr0)
Weakest part: the live capture (ScreencopyView supersampling, rounded mask, placeholder) is braided into WindowCard with grid-only concerns (packing rects, hover-selects, footer styles), so a second look would copy it. Unresolved force: a second consumer of live thumbnails now exists. Smallest move: extract WindowThumbnail (pure move, grid unchanged), then add the carousel as its own look and card over it. The controller stays look-agnostic: CarouselLook imports CarouselLayout.js directly.

## What
A selectable look 'carousel': windows on one arc, the selection large and front-centre, neighbours turned away in perspective with a floor reflection, spring-animated as the selection moves; title/app/workspace under the centre card. Left/Right move (through the existing windowLayout + neighbourIndex contract), Space Quick Look, Enter/click-centre activate, click a side card selects it, wheel scrolls. Hover does not select (it would spin the carousel).

GPU budget (Tahiti hang history): live capture only within ±k of the centre, reflection as a flipped ShaderEffectSource under a gradient, no per-card blur.

## Flagged assumption (cm-vph)
Grid-only settings (window labels style, selection highlight, Quick Look placement) stay visible and simply do not affect the carousel; hiding or greying them is a policy question for the operator.

## Acceptance
Layout unit tests (zero/one/many, symmetry, neighbour contract: (1,0)->i+1, (-1,0)->i-1, (0,±1)->-1 at any selection); ./validate green; live smoke with look carousel set and restored (Left/Right/Space/Enter-free close, no Escape); tests/live/check-settings-focus green; screenshots inspected.
close_reason: CarouselLook + CarouselCard over WindowThumbnail; CarouselLayout.js with 17 tests. Hand mutation: 13 mutants, survivors classified (offset<=0 at turn 0 equivalent; step-from-0 is a continuous constant shift = tuning, equivalent); 4 gaps found and covered by new tests. validate green; live: open centres the origin, Left/Right spring, Space Quick Look, filter, Enter activates and closes, no QML errors; check-settings-focus green under the carousel; screenshots inspected.

title: Juice: individually toggled motion effects
description:
## Diagnosis (cm-dr0)
Weakest part: motion is purely functional; nothing reacts to the user's input with feedback (dead arrow keys at the ends, instant activation, static selection). Unresolved force: operator asked for game-style juice with each effect its own option. Smallest move: one boolean setting per effect, read like every other schema setting, a Juice settings page (last, so existing number keys keep their pages), and each effect added as its own commit with its toggle. Edge bump and punch need the controller to tell looks about events it already handles (a move with no neighbour, an activation): two signals emitted only when the effect is on, so looks never re-check settings for them.

## What (one toggle each, default on — flagged assumption)
- juiceSpring: carousel spring overshoots and cards stretch along travel by the spring's lag; grid lift pops with overshoot.
- juiceEdgeBump: arrow with no neighbour: grid shakes the selected card along the arrow; carousel rubber-bands.
- juicePunch: activation plays a flash + zoom on the chosen card and a particle burst while the overlay fades, adding no delay to focus (operator's earlier 'no delay' activation decision stands).
- juicePulse: selection glow breathes.
- juiceTilt: hovered card leans toward the pointer.

## Acceptance
Schema tests cover the new settings (read/normalize/IPC on/off); theme test counts updated (approved assumption, values only); validate green; each effect seen live on and off in both looks (screenshots/frames inspected); check-settings-focus green; no QML errors in the journal.

title: Remove dead code and 1:1 wrappers
description: workspaceLabel unused; open(payload) ignores payload; isOnWorkspace/liveAspectRatioFor/formatWorkspaceLabel/captureSessionAspectRatios are 1:1 wrappers; unused imports across the Overview* chain; duplicate eligible-toplevel loops and toplevelListsEqual reimplementation in OverviewWindows; openSettings/closeSettings repeat the preview reset.
acceptance_criteria: No behaviour change; validate green; live smoke (open, filter, Tab, Space, settings) unchanged.
close_reason: 912d645 removed dead code, 42+4 unused imports, wrappers, duplicate loops; 7f? let conversion of 89 block-scoped vars. checks: 7/8 pass; qmllint has only 8 missing-property (6w7.4) and 2 id-shadows (6w7.6). Live smoke unchanged.

comments.author: elendal
comments.text: Close reason typo: the let conversion is d1910c5.

title: Selection by window reference, origin window everywhere
description: selectedIndex/previewIndex/previewExitIndex/hoveredIndex are positions in a rebuilt list; remap code and modelRevision bumps follow. Closing an earlier window while open shifts the selection. Nine sites compare Hyprland.activeToplevel, which no longer matches a card while the overlay holds focus.
acceptance_criteria: Selection survives filter/scope/window close; Outline 'current' border and workspace colouring show the origin window; tests cover selection survival.
close_reason: 6994620: selection by reference + WindowModel.selectionFor with tst_selection (8 pass; 4 hand mutants all killed). Live smoke unchanged. Not live-verified: closing a window while open (unit-tested only); origin highlight after shell restart needs one focus change (Quickshell).

title: Composition: non-visual controller, settings object, views via signals
description: Replace the inheritance chain with an OverviewController (QtObject) + settings object; surfaces connect to controller signals (focusRequested, settingsFocusRequested, dismissed); hot corner becomes its own component.
acceptance_criteria: No base-to-derived calls; lint clean for them; live behaviour unchanged.
close_reason: b346d85: lint has zero missing-property; checks 7/8 (qmllint only id-shadows, owned by 6w7.6); live smoke + activation + settings unchanged.

comments.author: elendal
comments.text: Move taken: acyclic layers via signals + moving functions to the layer that owns their dependencies, instead of a full QtObject composition rewrite. Force: the acceptance (no base-to-derived calls, lint clean) is met by the smaller move; the narrow controller surface looks need is defined in 6w7.6. Observed (pre-existing, not from this commit): opening Settings over IPC while the overview is closed loses initial keyboard focus until a number key is pressed.

title: Settings schema drives values, setters, IPC, pages
description: Each setting is defined in 4-6 places (state getter, setter, IPC, page options/ranges, test stub) and they drifted (IPC lacks initialWorkspaceScope/workspaceLabelStyle/showFooter; ranges duplicated).
acceptance_criteria: One schema; adding a setting touches one table plus its UI row; IPC validates via the schema; tests cover normalisation.
close_reason: 8a020ac: schema + tst_settings_schema (10 pass; 9 hand mutants killed after tightening one test). Live: IPC valid/invalid for every kind answered correctly, pages render schema options; shell.json restored.

title: Look interface; grid becomes the Grid look; Look selector
description: Minimal look interface: controller exposes windows, selected/preview/origin, select/hover/activate/close, iconFor, workspaceName, motionProgress, opened; a look supplies a view, layout(), neighbour(). Shared WindowThumbnail capture component. Footer bug: only Rail gets the framed background (operator decision).
acceptance_criteria: Grid look renders as before except the footer fix; Look selector in settings with Grid only; layout is a pure JS lib with a tst_ test.
close_reason: 326e095 footer fix (validate fully green), 37d96ff GridLayout.js + tst_grid_layout (10 tests; mutants killed except an equivalent size guard), 073f2c2 Look interface + GridLook, c7528ed Look page + IPC. Shared WindowThumbnail deferred to the first new look, which is its second user (cm-xrl).

title: Activation in-shell via Hyprland.dispatch, no fixed delay
description: activate-window spawns bash and sleeps 200 ms per switch. Dispatch focus from QML when the surface releases focus (operator decision); keep-pointer path may keep one cursorpos spawn.
acceptance_criteria: Switch latency has no fixed delay; activation works from all workspaces; move-pointer setting honoured.
close_reason: 3c6df2b: in-shell dispatch from finishDismiss. Live: Enter on filtered Claude focused it ~6 ms after the key tool returned; moveCursorToWindow off kept the pointer at 300,300. A/B: dispatch at startDismiss loses focus to the previous window.

title: Settings opened while closed gets keyboard focus
description:
What: `omarchy-shell expose settings open` while the overview is closed must leave keyboard focus on the settings category list, as it does when the overview is already open.

Evidence (2026-10-22): logged focus order on the live shell: category(entry), category(surface), keyCatcher, keyCatcher. The open sequence (prepareOpenSurface, completeMotion) requests the window's key catcher after settings asked for the category, and the last request wins. Two signals let a caller ask for the wrong target.

Acceptance: live check (scratchpad focus-check.sh: IPC settings open from closed, Down Down Right Left flips Selection highlight to Outline) red before, green after; positive control (open first) green; ./validate green; a motion preview from the Motion page keeps focus in settings.
close_reason: Single focusRequested signal; entry layer focuses settings (keeping a visible focused control) or the grid. tests/live/check-settings-focus: both checks red on 594873c, green on the fix; validate green; smoke clean.

title: Origin window known right after a shell restart
description:
What: the current-window mark (origin) must appear on the first open after a shell restart, without a prior focus change.

Evidence (2026-10-22): standalone quickshell probe: Hyprland.activeToplevel and ToplevelManager.activeToplevel are both null 1.5 s after start; after Hyprland.refreshToplevels() activeToplevel is set (focusHistoryID 0, activated true).

Acceptance: restart shell, open Exposé with no focus change, Lift dot on the focused window's card (screenshot); ./validate green. Known limit: an open within the refresh round-trip after restart can still miss.
close_reason: Not reproducible (false red, cm-j6g): after omarchy restart shell, opening immediately (and after 2 s) shows the Lift selection and origin dot on the focused window (screenshots origin-fast.png, origin-before.png). Quickshell's Hyprland toplevel list initializes lazily on first access; a bare probe that only reads activeToplevel at 1.5 s sees null, one that touches Hyprland.toplevels at start sees it set. Exposé touches Hyprland.toplevels at load (Connections target). No code change.
